title: MCP Masevha
allowPermissionsDesc: Kana yabatidzwa, ese MCP mafoni ezvishandiso anotenderwa otomatiki pasina kuratidza ma dialog emvumo. Maseting aya anoshanda pasi rose kunhaurirano dzese, kusanganisira itsva chats.

runtimeSettings.title: Runtime Settings
runtimeSettings.description: Gadzirisa kuti Novera anotonga sei uye anoedzazve MCP maseva.
runtimeSettings.toolCallTimeoutDesc: Nguva yakawanda yekumirira MCP mhinduro yekushandisa nguva isati yapera.
runtimeSettings.maxToolOutputCharsDesc: Chirevo chekushandisa chakareba chakachengetwa muhurukuro. Chese chakapfuura ichi chakachekwa uye chakatemwa sechidiki, saka imwe hombe mhedzisiro haigone kupedza mamiriro emuenzaniso. Isa kuna 0 kuti mibairo igare yakazara.
runtimeSettings.smartToolRoutingDesc: Kana yabatidzwa, Novera inosarudza MCP maseva akakodzera isati yasimudza maturusi. Dzima kuti ugare uchirodha MCP runyorwa rweturusi.
runtimeSettings.useLightweightRouterModelDesc: Kana smart routing iripo, mhanya nhanho yenzira neyakaparadzana (kazhinji diki) modhi pachinzvimbo chechat modhi. Dzima kuti ugare uchishandisa inoshanda chat modhi yekufambisa.
runtimeSettings.routerModelDesc: Sarudza mupi uye modhi munzvimbo imwechete. Mamodheru akareruka chete ndiwo akanyorwa saka nzira inogara ichikurumidza uye yakachipa.
runtimeSettings.routerModelEmptyList: Hapana mhando dzakareruka dziripo. Wedzera imwe modhi diki kana gadzira makiyi eAPI mumaModheru.
